question: Does the source-bound 400-dpi Tieqin p387 image require a forward-only correction of the current Zhunzhai copy-description metadata from 影鈔本 to 影鈔宋本, and what chronology/lineage claims does that wording actually authorize?
answer: YES. DIRECT 400-DPI REVIEW OF TIANYI 0004561 PDF P387 READS 準齋心製几漏圖式一卷 / 影鈔宋本 / 宋孫逢古撰并序. THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 銅壺漏箭制度 ENTRY INDEPENDENTLY ALSO READS 影鈔宋本. THE EARLIER 12EY 300-DPI AUDIT RECORD ABBREVIATED THE COPY DESCRIPTION AS 影鈔本; THAT HISTORICAL RECORD IS PRESERVED, WHILE CURRENT REGISTRY/GRAPH METADATA IS REPAIRED FORWARD-ONLY TO 影鈔宋本. THIS IS A QING BIBLIOGRAPHIC COPY-DESCRIPTION CLAIM ONLY AND DOES NOT PROVE A SURVIVING SONG PHYSICAL COPY, PRE-1578 EXACT 25-ARROW PROSE, SAME-OBJECT IDENTITY, OR SANMING PARENTAGE.
